```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
          token: ${{ secrets.AIRBYTE_AGENT_CONNECTORS_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install markdownlint-cli

      - name: Run markdownlint
        run: markdownlint docs/ai-agents/connectors/

      - name: Copy AI connector docs
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/ai-agents/connectors
          find . -type f -name "*.md" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/dist/*" -exec cp {} docs/ai-agents/connectors/ \;

      - name: Create PR
        id: create-pr
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: Sync AI connector docs
          title: Sync AI connector docs
          body: |
            This PR was automatically generated to sync AI connector documentation from the `airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors` repository.
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs
          labels: documentation,auto-merge
          reviewers: ian-at-airbyte

      - name: Clean up
        run: rm -rf airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
```
